deeper_source_adjudication.v17_base: EffectTerminalRuntimeV17Candidate directly subclasses historical unbound EffectLifecycleRuntime.
deeper_source_adjudication.v17_guard: EffectTerminalRuntimeV17GuardedCandidate only overrides record_reentry; it still inherits the historical unbound reservation/begin surface.
deeper_source_adjudication.existing_test_evidence: tests/effect_reentry_done_v17_candidate_gate.py seeds EffectTerminalRuntimeV17GuardedCandidate via atomic_effect_reservation_with_optional_confirmation_consumption() and begin_attempt() with no ExecutionGenerationFence before testing bound re-entry/DONE.
deeper_source_adjudication.scope_caveat: This proves an unsafe candidate API surface and lack of caller-bound provider integration, but does not by itself prove that a deployed production token/API entrypoint currently imports or instantiates that V17 candidate. That dynamic reachability remains to be measured.

strongest_counterhypothesis: The V17 candidate modules are diagnostic-only and unreachable from every admitted production effect entrypoint; therefore their inherited unbound B1/B2 methods cannot be exercised in deployed Frank v0.1.
next_falsifier: Build an entrypoint-rooted import/call graph plus a target execution trace from the ordinary authenticated action path. Require every effect-attempt edge to terminate in CallerBoundEffectLifecycleRuntime B1/B2/B3 + guarded_provider_commit. Separately make V17 terminalization expose only post-outcome evidence/re-entry/DONE capabilities or inherit the caller-bound lifecycle, then prove no unbound inherited start/retry method remains on any production-reachable object.

architecture_delta.decision: Do not promote F-V01-09 from mechanism support to product effect-authority closure. Preserve PR#250's caller-bound mechanism, but require non-bypassable production routing and remove/contain the V17 inherited unbound lifecycle surface before terminal receipt integration.
architecture_delta.preferred_design_direction: One effect execution authority path: admitted execution -> caller-bound B1/B2/B3 -> guarded provider attempt. Post-outcome reconciliation/re-entry/DONE may remain evidence-only after generation death, but terminalization code must not accidentally re-export historical unbound start/retry authority.

workflow_failure_interpretation: EXPECTED_DIAGNOSTIC_ASSERTION_FAILURE_FROM_NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE; physical Gate and current v6 normal matrix passed before the audit. The sole GO OOB step was skipped on this follow-up run, so no second OOB experiment was executed.
